title: State tag excludes a differently tagged state
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number, let $\Gamma$ and $I$ be types, and let $\mathrm{Ph}$ assign a type to each element of $I$. Choose $i\in I$, an element $v$ of the dependent sum of the types $\mathrm{Ph}(j)$ over $j\in I$, and a configuration $c$ on an input word $x$ whose states lie in $\mathrm{Ph}(i)$. If $i$ differs from the first component of $v$, then after replacing each state $q$ by the pair $(i,q)$, the configuration's state is not $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $K$ work tapes, symbols $\Gamma$, states $\mathrm{Ph}(i)$, and input $x$
